title: Claude, motion designer — self-promo reel

secondary_motion: back-out (17% overshoot), elastic and bounce shown explicitly; heavy motion-blur smears on type, stretched letters, particle sparks on the logo burst
color: coral, electric blue, acid lime, cream and black, a new flat color per section; colorfulness 59
typography: frame-filling extended black caps (EASE / IN. / OUT. / NEVER / LINEAR.) that smear, stretch, bounce per letter and tile into a repeating pattern
shape_language: precise geometry (circle → triangle → star → square morphs, dot sphere) mixed with organic truchet curves and a hand-drawn spark mark
character_humor: wit through the subject: 'Six ways to get from A to B', 'EASE IN. EASE OUT. NEVER LINEAR.'; no characters

signature: A motion designer's manifesto: each section demonstrates a principle (easing lanes, shape morphs, pattern, 3D dots) on a new flat color, then cuts on eighth notes into frame-filling smeared type that spells 'EASE IN. EASE OUT. NEVER LINEAR.'

music.summary: 129 BPM track with a clear pulse (0.51); the edit is locked to it: section cuts land on beats 4 and 8 beats apart, the type finale cuts every half beat then every beat, and the easing demo moves last exactly 2 beats (~0.93 s).

family_note: High energy (6.1) and expressive tone (8.0): squarely in the Playful reel zone. The content is self-referential (a demo of motion principles), so it doubles as a reference for the library's own token vocabulary.

behaviors.mechanism: dot travels A→B along a lane at constant speed (row 01 'linear' of the six-ways demo)
behaviors.notes: f253–f309 @60, x 660→1698 px, 18.5 px/f. All six dots start together on f252–f254 and each takes ~2 beats.
f254–f307 @60, rmse 0.001. No current token is a symmetric ease-in-out; candidate token.

behaviors.mechanism: dot A→B with exponential ease-out (row 03): 13% of travel in the first frame, then long deceleration
dot A→B with back-out: passes B by 17% then returns without oscillation (row 04)
dot accelerates (ease-in) into B and bounces back off it 3 times with decaying height (rebounds to 0.75, 0.94, 0.99 of travel) (row 06); elastic row 05 overshoots past B and oscillates ~4 times
behaviors.notes: Bounce: first impact f273 (20 f), impacts f294, f304, rest f309. Elastic: reaches B in ~5 f, swings to +16% (f258), -13% (f269), +5% (f277), -1.6% (f286), +0.7% (f294); a few blurred frames untracked.

behaviors.mechanism: one frame-filling word per shot on a new flat color (EASE / IN. / EASE / OUT. / NEVER / LINEAR.); each word slams in horizontally or vertically with a heavy motion-blur smear and settles in ~3–6 f; hard cut to the next word
behaviors.notes: Cut times measured (30 fps copy): 11.30, 11.53, 11.77, 12.00, 12.23 s = every half beat at 129 BPM, then 12.70, 13.17 = every beat. Smear/settle read from sheet f_.

behaviors.mechanism: 'NEVER' letters drop in one by one on an arc (N first, R last) and land, then the word duplicates into scrolling outlined rows that fill the frame

cream circle morphs triangle → star → rounded blob → square with a small rotation each time; a ring of satellite dots changes shape in sync (dots → triangles → stars → squares); red construction lines flicker behind
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet d_ (f366–f444 @60): a new shape every ~18–24 f.

behaviors.mechanism: a dot grows rays one by one into the spark mark, which spins, shrinks to a point, then a cream disc and a coral disc iris out to fill the frame on the beat; CLAUDE slides up letter-masked out of the baseline
behaviors.notes: Read from sheets a_/b_; iris at 1.93 s next to beat 1.95 s. Bookend: the end card repeats the spark burst + CLAUDE (13.2 s, on a beat).
